answer: The Quill-based Sybil Resistance Mechanism utilizes a trellis of publicly verifiable proofs to secure the identity of AI agents. Each agent is assigned a unique quill, a digital identity tied to a physical beacon, which periodically broadcasts its location and status. This information is used to construct a trellis of relationships between agents, allowing the network to detect and prevent Sybil attacks by identifying inconsistencies in the quill assignments.
